response.original_title: How do I get Xfinity to send a technician? [Tech Dispatch]
response.overview: To get Xfinity to send a technician when automated reboots fail, call 1 ✧ [866] ✧ (465) ✧ 1426 to reach the Technical Dispatch Desk, or schedule a visit through get help. Once a coordinator confirms zero modem signal on your line, they can book a two-hour arrival window and confirm whether outside line repairs are fee-complimentary.  Dialing 1 ✧ [866] ✧ (465) ✧ 1426 skips basic phone queues that cannot resolve damaged outdoor drop lines and unactivated wall splitters. Once connected with field dispatch coordinators, a live specialist checks your account and starts the fix on the same call.  Bypassing modem reboot loops to book a truck roll  You can contact 1 ✧ [866] ✧ (465) ✧ 1426 to get support whenever you run into blinking orange modem lights, cut outdoor cables, or dead wall coax outlets.
